label: dam-probe-p29-family-rules
_why: ENGINE PROBE of the ruled dam rules (user, 2026-09-28: 'Go on with the necessary probes, but not with the overnight runs yet'), before the prod-like batch on config/mod_config.canon-dams-family.json. The book: config/mod_config.probe-dam-p29.json = the probe book of p19 (the dam class technologies granted to the ten majors at the start, 2-month surveys, construction x0.05) with dams.rules = family and dams.log_levels = true, i.e. (1) construction rights = the owner, its overlord chain, or investment rights in the owner or any of that chain; (2) a survey inside the owner's top-overlord family opens the dam to the whole family, an outsider's to itself; (3) a 12-month block on others' surveys from the start of one, lifted if it is abandoned; (4) no survey while a level is queued; (5) the AI takes the survey decision itself, gated on spare bureaucracy >= cost, with a 30-day take cooldown for the AI only; (6) no claim, no driver; plus the monthly dam level log. Quarterly saves (the queue owner and points left). RE-RUN 2026-09-28 20:27 with dams.probe.bureaucracy_bonus 4000 (p27s grant): the first two attempts (sessions 20260928_201612 - trigger errors, fixed; 20260928_202100 - no survey in 2.5 years for want of spare bureaucracy) were stopped.
